events.title: Devlog: Convoy Ambush Mission
events.summary: Hello everyone!I can’t wait to show you my progress on developing an ambitious new convoy ambush mission for my game. The player's main objective is to intercept and neutralize enemy transport units along their transit route.When designing the map, the biggest challenge was getting the scale just right. events.title: Devlog: Outpost Buildings
events.summary: Hello! I want to demonstrate the progress in the development of Outpost Buildings.A well-equipped outpost serves as a base of operations for your fighters. At outposts, fighters can heal from injuries, sleep, and craft and upgrade weapons and equipment.To build outpost buildings, you need materials, which can be purchased in the store. events.title: Devlog: Resource Management - Hunger Mechanics
events.summary: Hello! I want to demonstrate the progress in developing resource management, trade, and the hunger and dehydration mechanics. Resources necessary to maintain the combat readiness of the squad can be obtained through trade and by completing missions. The most important resources are food and water. Their shortage leads to a decrease in the squad's combat readiness and even the death of fighters from hunger or dehydration. events.title: Devlog: Coordinated attack
events.summary: Hello!I am very excited to share the progress on the command mode for NPC companions. Attack and hold fire commands allow you to set up ambushes with NPC companions and coordinate fire.If things get hot and you are badly hurt, NPC companions will come to the rescue after securing the area.Thank you very much for watching.Please support me on my Patreon.Stay tuned for more news and updates!

events.title: Devlog: Squad Tactics - Assault Drone
events.summary: Hello!I am very excited to share with you the progress in squad management. I present to you a ground assault drone. This drone can be used for reconnaissance and fire support. With the help of this fearless mechanical partner, you can catch the enemy off guard, implement various tactics without risking the health of living squad members.Thank you very much for watching.Please support me on my Patreon.Stay tuned for more news and updates!

events.title: Devlog: Global map. Air defense encounter
events.summary: Hello!I am very excited to show you my progress on the implementation of squad movement on the global map and the new mechanics for firing from a Man-Portable Air Defense System (MANPADS).Thank you very much for watching.Please support me on my Patreon.Stay tuned for more news and updates!

events.title: Devlog: Mission objectives on the map
events.summary: Hello!I have added a map of the mission area and a display of mission objectives on the map. In this example we need to destroy an enemy self-propelled howitzer.

events.title: Devlog: Procedural interior
events.summary: Hello!I developed a system of procedural interiors. To diversify the rooms in the game, the walls of the rooms are painted in one of the pre-set color styles. Furniture is randomly placed based on pre-set layouts.Follow me on social media to stay up to date with the latest updates.Please support me on Patreon.Stay tuned!

events.title: Devlog: Suppressive Fire
events.summary: Hello!For the last two weeks, I've been practically drowning in code, refining and deepening the combat system and AI. I am very excited to show you a new mechanic - Suppressive Fire.From a tactical point of view, suppressive fire is used to prevent the enemy from shooting at you and to allow for movement to a more advantageous position. events.title: Devlog: Arrest procedure
events.summary: Hello! I continue to improve the enemy AI. Now they can try to arrest you if the character has no weapon in his hands and no rifle on his back. Of course, a rocket launcher on your back will also prevent an arrest.:) Sidearm is allowed, but only in a holster. Oh, how I want to add the QuickDraw ability, so that you can escape from such a situation.:) Please, write what you think in the comments.

events.title: New Optics Shooting Mode LIVE!
events.summary: Hello! A top-down camera is very good for making tactical decisions. But sometimes it creates a problem with long-range shooting. I present to you a new shooting mode for weapons with optics. In this mode, the camera "detaches" from the character and allows you to use the sight mounted on the weapon – from iron sights to optical sights. Subscribe to my social networks to stay up to date with news and updates. Thank you for playing!

In addition to the above, I added a character highlight behind the walls.
